name: verify_agent_command_safety
title: Autonomous Agent Pre-Execution Command & Prompt Injection Gate
description: Evaluates untrusted agent prompts, bash commands, and tool arguments to block prompt injection, destructive shell commands, and private-key exfiltration. annotations.title: AST-Level Read-Only SQL Query & Injection Safety Validator
